headline: UK Chancellor Unveils 2026 Budget with £100 Energy Support Package
summary: UK Chancellor John Healey introduced the 2026 budget, offering a £100 payment to 20 million households and a £4.7 billion first-homebuyer scheme. Measures were funded by an increased tax levy on bank profits and frozen income tax thresholds.
why: The UK fiscal budget sets taxation levels, government borrowing, and public spending across the fifth-largest national economy.

impacts.name: UK Banking Sector
impacts.why: Higher bank profit levies reduce net earnings for domestic lenders.

why_moved: Targeted tax increases on banks and frozen personal tax brackets rebalanced domestic fiscal expectations.
